newsitem.title: MEXICO: Mexico's Gissa started with buying rating.
newsitem.headline: Mexico's Gissa started with buying rating.

text.p: Brokerage Ing Barings said Thursday it had initiated coverage of Mexican conglomerate Grupo Industrial Saltillo (Gissa) with a buy recommedation.
Ing Barings analyst Daniel Goldstein said Gissa was expected to increase sales by 20 percent in 1998, due in part to larger auto supply contracts.
Goldstein said in a report that his recommendation was also baed on the potential of price appreciation.
"With NAFTA, the company took a dominant position in Mexico's auto parts and engine manufacturing and now plans to expand its engine block capacity by 30 percent by the end of 1997," he said.
Ing Barings set a Gissa year-end target price per share of $3.31 for 1997 and $4.20 for 1998, representing an annualized appreciation of over 20 percent.
